# DataGridRowDropPosition

`Flare.Components.DataGridRowDropPosition`

Where a dragged row lands relative to the row under the pointer.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Before` | `0` | Before the target row, as its sibling. |
| `After` | `1` | After the target row, as its sibling. |
| `Inside` | `2` | Inside the target row, as its last child. |
